```php
namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Faker\Factory;

class UserSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run()
    {
        $faker = Factory::create();

        for ($i = 0; $i < 10; $i++) {
            User::create([
                'name' => $faker->name(),
                'email' => $faker->unique()->email(),
                'password' => bcrypt('password123'),
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```
